title: $Ω$-results for the logarithmic derivative of $ζ(s)$ on vertical homogeneous progressions
summary: In this paper, we establish $Ω$-results for the logarithmic derivative of the Riemann zeta function on vertical homogeneous progressions on the 1-line and in the critical strip. Compared with Yang's work in 2023, our results show that the discrete case has a similar order of magnitude to the continuous case.
